sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Follow the active mission objectives through the mine.
The reviewed script gives Clicktok a peaceful quest-material exchange and a hostile response if hailed without it.
Keep the group ready before starting that conversation.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 2.

The version-2 loader selects find_fibblebrap_five, but that file repeats the Find Fibblebrap 1 header, task IDs and much of its objective logic. Fifth-mission identity and objective correctness remain unresolved; this is a provisional source-backed draft.
